# Selling.com

> Selling.com is a pipeline generation platform combining sales automation, lead intelligence, and contact discovery to help B2B sales and marketing teams identify and engage prospects.

Selling.com provides an integrated suite of tools for lead generation, outreach automation, and buyer intelligence. The platform serves sales teams across major markets including Boston, Houston, Chicago, Los Angeles, Atlanta, and New York City, with integrations for popular CRM systems like Salesforce and Zoho.

## Key Topics

- Sales Automation
- Lead Generation
- Pipeline Generation
- Email Outreach
- Contact Discovery
- BuyerWatch Intelligence
- Real-time Verification
- Sales Signals
- Technographics
- CRM Integration
- LinkedIn Integration
- Chrome Extension
- API Integration
- GDPR Compliance
- Data Protection

## Core Platform Features

- [Workflows](https://selling.com/workflows): Workflow automation platform for email/call sequences and CRM integration
- [Outreach](https://selling.com/outreach): Outreach tool for sales automation, email sequences, and prospecting
- [Pricing](https://selling.com/pricing): Selling.com pricing plans for sales automation and contact database

## Lead Intelligence & Targeting

- [Advanced Search](https://selling.com/solutions/advanced-search): Advanced search tool for lead generation with firmographics and NAICS filtering
- [BuyerWatch](https://selling.com/solutions/buyerwatch): BuyerWatch solution for automated job change tracking and buyer intelligence
- [Signals](https://selling.com/solutions/signals): Sales signals and buying triggers for account insights and prospect engagement
- [Technographics Intelligence](https://selling.com/all-use-cases/technographics): Technographics intelligence for B2B tech stack targeting and competitive analysis

## Contact Data & Verification

- [Real-time Verification](https://selling.com/solutions/real-time-verification): Real-time email verification and contact data validation for deliverability
- [Chrome Extension](https://selling.com/solutions/free-chrome-extension): Chrome extension for discovering emails and phone numbers on LinkedIn

## API Reference

- [Web API Documentation](https://selling.com/documentation/web-api): Selling.com API documentation covering authentication, enrichment, and HTTP requests
